email_subject: Application - Marketing Intern, KitKat (Confectionery) at Nestlé
email_body:
Dear Nestlé Recruitment Team,

I would like to apply for the Marketing Intern role with the KitKat Confectionery team in Brussels, starting in January 2027.

My day-to-day work sits close to this brief: writing and publishing content, building and maintaining product catalogues on Shopify, and preparing pages so products are actually found, including the structured data and images that make them visible in search and on e-commerce platforms. I work in WordPress daily, use Canva for visuals, and coordinate with clients and stakeholders to keep long-running projects on track.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, available for the full six months, and work in fluent English. My Dutch is at B1 writing level and improving.

I would welcome the chance to bring this to KitKat. My CV is attached.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the KitKat Marketing Internship in Brussels, starting in January 2027. Most of my work sits in the space this role touches: getting products found online, and making them look right once they are.

At Episto I run on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, and I manage CMS content daily in WordPress: pages, blog posts, media. For two Shopify stores, harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com, I designed the store, built and maintained the product catalogue and wrote the supporting blog content. That is the same discipline behind e-commerce assets: accurate product information, clean images, and pages that stay consistent when a range changes.

At Knowledge Experts I worked on SharePoint-based projects for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, which taught me how retail and logistics teams actually use the platforms built for them, and how much depends on a clear briefing. I also built client websites end to end, including social media integration, so coordinating with agencies on POS material and print would follow a pattern I already know: short briefs, tight feedback loops, and checking the details before anything goes live.

My toolkit is WordPress, Elementor, WooCommerce, Shopify, Canva, Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs, plus AI tools I use daily for research and drafting. I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium and available for six months. I work in fluent English; my Dutch is at B1 writing level and I am actively improving it.

I would be glad to talk about how I can support the KitKat team.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
- E-commerce and product content: design, catalogue build and maintenance, and supporting blog content for Shopify stores harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com, plus WooCommerce experience.
- CMS and website management: WordPress, Elementor, Astra and Rank Math, publishing and updating pages, posts and media for client sites, including a consistent layout for ~600 member profile pages at majistraleczacilari.org.tr.
- SEO and content at Episto: keyword research, on-page SEO and SEO writing for retail, consultancy and e-commerce clients, tracked with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console.
- Customer-facing and stakeholder work: building site structure and social media integration for client websites, working alongside teams on large retail and logistics projects (ŞOK Market, Aras Kargo), visual work in Canva.
- Languages and availability: English fluent, Turkish native, Dutch B1 writing / A2+ speaking and improving; based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium; available for a six-month internship from January 2027.
